units.en: Every day, Lenovo employees create valuable knowledge.
units.zh: 每天，联想员工都在创造宝贵的知识。

units.en: We create presentations, reports, training materials, and operational processes.
units.zh: 我们制作演示文稿、报告、培训材料和运营流程。

units.en: But there is one challenge we all face:
units.zh: 但我们都面临着一个挑战：

units.en: It lives in emails, shared drives, SharePoint sites, Teams channels, documents, videos,
units.zh: 它存在于电子邮件、共享驱动器、SharePoint 站点、Teams 频道、文档和视频中，

units.en: and sometimes only in people's heads.
units.zh: 有时甚至只存在于人们的脑海里。

units.en: When knowledge is scattered, unstructured, difficult to find, and hard to maintain,
units.zh: 当知识分散、缺乏结构、难以查找且难以维护时，

units.en: employees spend valuable time searching for information instead of using it.
units.zh: 员工便会把宝贵的时间花在寻找信息上，而不是使用信息。

units.en: And as Lenovo continues to invest in AI,
units.zh: 随着联想持续投入 AI，

units.en: the quality and accessibility of our knowledge becomes even more critical.
units.zh: 我们知识的质量与可获取性变得更加关键。

units.en: Because AI is only as effective as the knowledge it can access.
units.zh: 因为 AI 的效能，取决于它所能获取的知识。

source_text: Every day, Lenovo employees create valuable knowledge. We document best practices. We solve customer problems. We develop products. We create presentations, reports, training materials, and operational processes. But there is one challenge we all face: Knowledge is everywhere. It lives in emails, shared drives, SharePoint sites, Teams channels, documents, videos, and sometimes only in people's heads. When knowledge is scattered, unstructured, difficult to find, and hard to maintain, employees spend valuable time searching for information instead of using it. And as Lenovo continues to invest in AI, the quality and accessibility of our knowledge becomes even more critical. Because AI is only as effective as the knowledge it can access.
